meta.title: feat(root): migrate from ESLint and Prettier to Biome
meta.body_summary: Migrate entire Novu monorepo from ESLint/Prettier to Biome, claiming improved linting/formatting performance and reduced dependencies.

perf_labels.notes: Devin migration of monorepo to Biome introduced multiple bugs detected by cursor[bot]; PR closed by bot for inactivity without human review.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At 12,371 changed lines across 90 files, this is a large-scale infrastructure refactor by absolute volume, primarily driven by a 10,810-line lockfile change and removal of legacy ESLint/Prettier configs. It was closed—not merged—due to multiple correctness bugs and lack of human review engagement.

review_details.concern_detail: cursor[bot] flagged: (1) lint:fix scripts passing --fix instead of --write; (2) OpenAPI validate action using biome:check instead of lint:openapi; (3) getEntries function default parameters removed; (4) userRepository renamed to _userRepository but method calls still reference this.userRepository.
review_details.performance_claim: Biome provides faster linting/formatting and reduces dependency complexity compared to ESLint+Prettier.
review_details.rejection_signals: Multiple correctness bugs identified by cursor[bot]; PR closed by devin-ai-integration[bot] for inactivity after 2 hours without human review.

capability_boundary.boundary_notes: Large-scale monorepo toolchain migration without human oversight; agent introduced several technical bugs and no human reviewer engaged, leading to bot close.

detection_detail.code_reading: cursor[bot] statically analyzed the PR changes and identified bugs.

maintainer_practices.reproducibility_notes: No benchmarks or before/after timing data; only narrative claims of speed improvement.
maintainer_practices.regression_detail: PR closed by bot with no merge; bugs not fixed.

core_change_summary.description: Migrate monorepo from ESLint and Prettier to Biome: added biome.json with comprehensive config, removed all ESLint/Prettier configs and dependencies, updated 29+ package.json lint scripts to use biome check, updated CI workflows and Docker files.
core_change_summary.secondary_note: Most line changes are in pnpm-lock.yaml (removal of ESLint dependencies) and deletions of old configs; the core new file is biome.json.
change_trajectory: Initial commit: full migration with biome.json and removal of ESLint/Prettier.
Subsequent commits: fix Nx config conflicts, enable parameter decorators, resolve TypeScript errors, and adjust enterprise packages.

review_signals.summary: lint:fix scripts across packages pass --fix instead of --write, causing failures.
Repeated flagging of the same --fix vs --write issue across multiple package.json files.
OpenAPI validate action incorrectly set to biome:check instead of lint:openapi, breaking OpenAPI validation.
getEntries function default parameters removed causing potential runtime errors.
UserRepository renamed to _userRepository but internal calls still reference this.userRepository.
Closing due to inactivity for more than 7 days.

collaboration_trajectory: Devin opened PR with full migration (1,783 additions, 10,241 deletions across 90 files).
cursor[bot] rapidly reviewed and flagged lint fix script issues and two source code bugs within 40 minutes.
Devin committed three follow-up fixes addressing Nx config, parameter decorators, and TypeScript errors, but did not fix all flagged issues.
No human reviewer engaged; devin-ai-integration[bot] closed PR after 2 hours.
